newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Specials hoist Bucharest bourse to record turnover.
newsitem.headline: Specials hoist Bucharest bourse to record turnover.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest stock exchange soared to an all-time high at 65.5 billion lei on Thursday thanks to large special deals in two first- tier stocks struck by foreign investors, traders said.
The previous record was 25.9 billion lei, on Wednesday.

"Recent turnover levels place Romania alongside the other markets of eastern Europe and show foreigners taking serious interest in our equities," a broker said. "Investment rules announced this week have certainly made a change."
Thursday's special deals -- trades outside the exchange and reported later -- involved Oltchim chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures and were worth a total of more than 49 billion lei.

But both high-caps closed lower, with Oltchim shedding 1,400 lei to 2,100 and Azomures losing 1,300 lei to 2,500. "The lower prices were brought by the special deals," said a trader. Sellers accepted lower prices due to large volumes involved."
Two special deals in Oltchim involved a total 13 million shares, while Azomures traded 9.3 million shares in two deals.
Earlier this week, Romania announced a 1.5 percent tax on each portfolio buying deal, amending previous portfolio flows rules which set a four percent fee on capital gains.

Some brokers and analysts said the new tax, generally viewed as prohibitive, will diminish flows into the market, which will be too expensive. They said a fall in the equities market was to be expected with the new tax coming into force.
But others said the market had enough potential to render the new tax bearable. "There are promises of high returns and for bigger investors 1.5 percent won't count," an analyst said.
Other fine performers at Thursday's session were first-tier Antibiotice, refrigerator maker Arctic and second-tier Policolor dye maker.

Antibiotice had 2.2 billion lei in turnover and closed 200 lei higher at 5,900 and Arctic traded shares worth 2.2 billion lei, ending 350 lei weaker at 3,100. Policolor had 1.2 billion lei in turnover and gained 50 lei to close at 5,800.
Average prices of 13 stocks fell, 11 climbed and six stayed flat. Nine companies had no trades and two were suspended.

Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, plunged due to big falls in the average prices of high-caps. The VAB fell 18.3 percent from Wednesday and the BIG lost 18.53 percent. The BIG first-tier index was 22.44 percent down at 3,486.87 points.
